In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the statistical multifragmention model is in agreement with the experimental results and the critical indices obtained by the model are in good agreement with the experimental data.
the statistical multifragmentization model is not a critical phenomenon in the Fisher's sense, but the model is a critical phenomenon in a sense of a new type, the so-called  τ -criticality.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the statistical multifragmention model has the same critical indices for all values of the parameter τ.
the statistical multifragmentization model is a good candidate to describe the multifragmentation process of heavy ion collisions.
the statistical multifragmention model predicts the existence of a critical point for nuclear multifragmentation and the critical indices of the model are different from Fisher's droplet model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the critical exponents are not universal and depend on the Fisher parameter τ.
